machineTrack: scripts/recomp/ static recompiler - ROUND 8 (2026-08-31): wide-varnode gap CLOSED, boot advanced to the archive re-open. WHAT LANDED: (1) lift.py now lowers wide CALLOTHER through a new `recomp_otherw_*` convention (every operand passed as pointer+size; SLEIGH puts the OLD DEST first, so a1 is the source), wide INT_NEGATE/INT_2COMP (recomp_wide_not/_2comp) and wide SUBPIECE; lift failures 73 -> 26, .text coverage 96.44% -> 96.73%, sub_00ab2d80 lifts. Only pshuflw/pshufhw are implemented in recomp_rt.c - the other 28 wide intrinsic names are weak self-naming aborts from mkstubs.py. (2) NEW ORACLE: scripts/recomp/oracle/wideops.py lifts ONE x86 instruction with the real lifter, compiles it against the real recomp_rt.c, and diffs 200 random XMM vectors against Unicorn; 12 cases incl. 4 controls; tests/recomp-wideops.test.js, 2.7 s. (3) IT FOUND A REAL SILENT MISCOMPILE: Ghidra's ia.sinc gives PSLLD/PSLLQ (xmm) a PER-LANE shift count; hardware uses the low 64 bits of the source for every lane. 12 real `pslld xmm,xmm` sites in .text (0x926623.., 0xad18a7..), all with a movd-loaded count so lanes 1..3 were left unshifted. Fixed by packed_shift_defect() in lift.py; fires on exactly 48 lanes = 12x4, which is the census. (4) REPRODUCIBILITY: emit.py records argv in summary.json; new --hand-written flag reads the authoritative VA set out of scripts/recomp/host/src/missing_fns.c so the lifter never duplicates a hand-transcribed body (5 of the 6 became liftable this round, and their lifted forms reach unimplemented AVX-512 intrinsics). --trace-va is LOAD-BEARING for the boot build: RECOMP_VA markers are what patch_reentry.py and mkdispatch.py scan for call continuations; without it dispatch_tbl.c does not compile.
